name: Sprocket
text:
Decision: We should build a lightweight “prompt review bot” that runs after every prompt edit, checks for common issues (like vague instructions or missing constraints), and suggests fixes in plain language—no code, no file paths, just a yes/no + a short reason.

Why: This keeps quality high without slowing anyone down. The trade-off is that we’re adding a small upfront cost to set up the bot, but it pays off by catching mistakes early and teaching the team better habits over time. It’s the fastest way to make “quality first” automatic.
